_doc: heroes3 리뷰(heroes3rev) 에이전트의 클링 생성 기록 — azel·NPC 검수 중 새로 만든 원화만. 생산 기록은 kling_manifest_heroes3.json (건드리지 않음). images = 과금 이미지 수(후보 포함).

inputs: azel_dhampir_back.jpg (ym90 crop of turn5, back design)
entries.prompt: One single full-body THREE-QUARTER BACK view of the young man in 图片1, wearing exactly the outfit of 图片1 (图片2 shows the same man and outfit seen straight from behind): long flowing silver-white hair down his back, a black leather long frock coat with thin gold trim edges and a dark crimson lining, a high black collar, black leather gloves with gold-buttoned cuffs, black trousers and black knee boots. Camera angle: halfway between a back view and a left side view. His whole body is turned about 45 degrees away from the viewer toward the LEFT edge of the picture: we see his back at an angle and a little of his left side, NOT a symmetric back view. His head faces the left edge of the picture, so we see the back of his head and only a sliver of his pale cheek and the tip of his nose in lost profile on the left side; we cannot see his eyes. His toes point toward the upper left. He stands in a relaxed neutral pose with both arms hanging down at his sides, alone and centered, the same size as in 图片1. Plain light-grey studio background, the same painterly dark-fantasy game-art style as 图片1, soft even lighting, complete from the top of the head to the boots with margin, nothing cropped, no cape, no wings, nothing held in the hands, no text, no watermark.
entries.note: 리뷰: 기존 qback 두 인물이 모두 정면 뒷모습(좌우 대칭)이라 턴테이블 −45/−90/−135 가 같은 그림 → a = 왼쪽으로 돌아선 3/4 뒤(옆뺨·코끝만 보임) → ym135 채택, ym45 는 거울상. 옛 qback 두 인물은 라벨 "-"
